response.sql:
WITH feature_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    SUM(traitcount) as site_features
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(site_features) as total_features,
    COUNT(*) as site_count
  FROM feature_totals
),
shares_and_margins AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.zoneref,
    ft.site_features,
    ft.site_features * 1.0 / os.total_features as share,
    (ft.site_features * 1.0 / os.total_features) - (1.0 / os.site_count) as margin
  FROM feature_totals ft
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  site_features as feature_count,
  share,
  margin
FROM shares_and_margins
WHERE margin > 0
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing detected-feature counts" means filtering WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL, excluding NULL values from aggregation
"Average share" is defined as 1 / (count of distinct sites), representing the proportion each site would hold under even distribution
Only sites with feature records in scanfeatures are considered; sites from the sites table without feature records are excluded
